brief.who: A UK parent of a 9 to 11 year old who is into space and already watches YouTube.
brief.why: Show the work behind one playlist, so a parent sees what we cut and why before they trust what we kept.
brief.cta: Send it to a parent with a space mad child; then Get a free playlist.
brief.hooks: Slide 1 is a curiosity gap. Slide 2 stands alone, because Instagram re-shows a carousel from slide 2 to people who scrolled past slide 1.
brief.source: Safe Watch handoff, week of 5 October: why we chose this playlist, and the internal playlist notes. Hiniker et al, CHI 2018, already verified for series-10.

list: Where does the next click go?
